source_audit.shared_chat_factory: one resolved model/base_url/api_key tuple creates one client; SDK max_retries stay on that client
source_audit.session_snapshot: core session resolves paired provider configuration from one core_config snapshot
source_audit.settings_update: owner settings save persists new config, then ends active sessions and reloads configuration

overlay_policy.startup_preflight: explicit direct-provider allowlist; unknown hosts fail closed
overlay_policy.manual_provider_change: explicit owner operation; rerun provider preflight before continuing private XiaoYu use
overlay_policy.reason: A core patch would exist only to police an explicit owner settings change, while automatic fallback and per-session drift are already bounded. Keep the overlay smaller.

caveat: This does not claim that N.E.K.O prevents an owner from manually saving a disallowed provider while already running. XiaoYu treats that as an explicit configuration change and requires preflight before subsequent private use.
